text:
asha: quick heads-up — we need a short, personalized status + mitigation note to affected customers from yesterday's embeddings outage. goal: reduce renewal risk and invite to a live triage + training session. draft below, pls react with edits.

marco: thanks — do we have list of impacted tenants by revenue tier? want to tailor credits + exec reach.

priya: pushing export now, should have seg by EOD. small flag: a few dedicated customers hit timeouts but no data loss.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-EMBEDS: Partial degradation of embedding service (503s) caused by upstream cache eviction. Mitigation applied 03:12 UTC; root cause under investigation. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2026-03-21-embeds

asha: ok copying that line into the customer note. Proposed subject: "Update on yesterday's embedding service disruption — next steps & invite" — thoughts? :email:

sam: subject is fine. Recommend offering 10% invoice credit for high-touch tiers, 20% for P0 impacted accounts, and 1-on-1 enablement session.

marco: +1 for tiered credit. can we make enablement session optional with a recorded replay for lower tiers?

priya: session + recording is doable. ops will run a 45min deep-dive walkthru on prompt design to avoid cache bumps and how to use prefix caching.

asha: draft email body (please only minor edits):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We want to apologize for the embedding interruptions you experienced on 2026-03-21. Our team identified a cache eviction that caused higher-than-normal 503s for a subset of requests. Mitigation has been applied and service stability is restored.

As a next step we are offering:
- Tiered invoice credit (applied automatically)
- Live troubleshooting + enablement session (optional) — book here: https://cal.redwood/embeds-officehours
- Technical notes & recommended config tweaks: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeds-recommendations

If you'd like a proactive review of your setup, reply to this email and we'll schedule with our eng + CS lead.

Sincerely,
The Redwood Customer Success Team
```

elaine: looks good. hold the % numbers until we confirm impacted list. also add a line about how we're preventing recurrence (autoscaling thresholds + cache TTL guardrails).

asha: added recurrence mitigation note. updated body and saved as template: /templates/embeds-incident-2026-03-21.

marco: next: segmentation send plan? I propose: P0/P1 manual outreach from AMs, P2 personalized template via CS ops, others automated digest.

priya: confirmed — export will include tier tag and last 90d usage. ETA 20m.

sam: ops will queue credit calculations once segment ready. rough runbook:
- export list -> confirm impacted flag -> calculate credits -> schedule apply job -> send email batch (staggered)

asha: scheduling note: want to send manual outreach within 4 hours of final seg. Can all AMs ack? @marco @elaine pls route to AMs.

marco: I can ping AMs. will ask for priority outreach for any renewal within 90 days.

elaine: approve the plan. suggest we also offer a short executive summary call for accounts > $50k ARR. I'll join if needed.

asha: perfect. one last thing — capture feedback after sessions. proposed post-session survey (1-2 q): "Did this reduce your outage impact?" + "Would you like deeper enablement or architecture review?"

priya: add a quick CS ops tag in the survey to route requests to eng. we can wire in a webhook to the ticketing queue.

sam: noted. I'll add one-time webhook to /support/incident-embeds so follow-ups create a ticket with customer tags.

asha: thanks team. action items:
- priya: finish impacted export by 18:55 UTC (in progress)
- marco: mobilize AMs for P0/P1 manual outreach (async)
- sam: prepare credit job & support webhook (standby)
- elaine: standby for exec calls > $50k ARR
- all: review template at /templates/embeds-incident-2026-03-21 and comment by +1h

please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your item. I'll kick off the send when we have final seg.

marco: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: (export done)

sam: :thumbsup: prepping job

elaine: :thumbsup: available for execs

asha: closing loop here once send completes — will post final send log and affected-account list. thanks everyone!
